name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio site. The EV tracker is a dependency-free app; these scripts are developer tooling only and produce no build output. The two layout pages are generated by tools/emit-pages.mjs from app/shell.mjs and committed as plain HTML, so the site still ships with no build step.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run fmt:check && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:markup
scripts.test:unit: node tools/test-roles.mjs && node tools/test-storage.mjs && node tools/test-bin.mjs && node tools/test-sync-status.mjs && node tools/test-location.mjs
scripts.test:markup: node tools/test-dom.mjs && node tools/test-wiring.mjs && node tools/test-i18n-markup.mjs && node tools/test-ui.mjs && node tools/test-time-fields.mjs && node tools/test-mileage.mjs && node tools/test-consumption.mjs && node tools/test-phase1.mjs && node tools/test-phase2.mjs && node tools/test-phase4.mjs && node tools/test-stations.mjs && node tools/test-layouts.mjs && node tools/test-layout-wide.mjs && node tools/test-guard.mjs && node tools/test-sw-bump.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run fmt
